analytic_bridge.falsification_consequence: Delay 17 is impossible; the exact fixed-k cocycle redirects the frontier to anti-shadowing for totient-letter words in a moving window.
analytic_bridge.survival_consequence: A genuine universal delay cap would directly feed the canonical Mersenne residue-gap supply.

experiment_contract.authority_boundary: Experiment metadata and finite computation are evidence, not proof authority; claim status changes only through Lean, an exact counterexample, or the named owner verifier.

hypothesis.statement: Every pure-dyadic canonical residue escapes the endpoint window within 17 heights after the central interval first becomes nonempty.

probe.computation: Sieve phi through c=1000000, update Q_H and M_H exactly through H=100, and verify E_(H+1)=2E_H+phi(c+H+1)-k on each record endpoint word.
probe.falsifier: An exact c with post-geometry-clear delay above 17; a quotient change inside its trapped word would falsify the fixed-k model.
probe.question: Do exact totient words produce a delay beyond 17, and is their trap governed by a fixed-quotient affine error cocycle?
probe.stop_condition: Stop after the first scan range containing a new delay record above 17 and bind its complete signed endpoint word.

problem.claim_ceiling: Finite pure-dyadic scan, an exact affine recurrence, and exact prime-successor bottom-lock certificates; no proof of unbounded delay, universal residue escape, or irrationality.

result.summary: At c=490794 geometry clears at H=20, the fixed quotient k=327611 keeps the signed error endpoint-trapped through H=38, and escape first occurs at H=39: exact delay 19, eliminating delay<=17.  Every prime argument inside every record word also satisfies the exact adjacent-error excursion inequality p-1-k <= |E_H|+2|E_(H-1)|.  Whenever its successor is still trapped, the directional certificate 4E_(H-1)+p+phi(p+1) <= 4+3k is also verified.
